channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK avoids ruling out force against Russian shadow fleet
item.description: In a written question, Lord West of Spithead asked why Maritime Counter-Terrorism forces were not being used to stop vessels linked to Russia’s shadow fleet when transiting the Channel or other waters close to the UK. The post UK avoids ruling out force against Russian shadow fleet first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Defence signs logistics mobilisation pact with nine firms
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed it is working with industry to improve the UK ability to mobilise logistics personnel during times of crisis, following a parliamentary question on workforce preparedness. The post Defence signs logistics mobilisation pact with nine firms first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy tracks Russian shadow tanker off Gibraltar
item.description: Royal Navy forces monitored a sanctioned Russian-linked oil tanker as it transited the Strait of Gibraltar, ahead of a subsequent French boarding operation, as part of wider allied efforts to disrupt Moscow’s so-called shadow fleet. The post Royal Navy tracks Russian shadow tanker off Gibraltar first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Fleet Solid Support ship construction begins in Spain
item.description: Construction of the Fleet Solid Support ships is under way in Cádiz, with further work set to start shortly in Belfast and Appledore. The post Fleet Solid Support ship construction begins in Spain first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Scottish ministers eye Inchgreen revival for marine jobs
item.description: The Scottish Government has said it is actively engaging with industry on the future redevelopment of Inverclyde's Inchgreen Marine Park, citing potential growth across shipbuilding, vessel repair, freight and maritime tourism. The post Scottish ministers eye Inchgreen revival for marine jobs first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Damen LST 100 chosen for US Navy landing ship plan
item.description: Damen Shipyards Group has confirmed that its Landing Ship Transport 100 design has been selected by the US Navy as the basis for its new Landing Ship Medium programme. The post Damen LST 100 chosen for US Navy landing ship plan first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Kongsberg joins bid for Norway new navy vessel fleet
item.description: Kongsberg Maritime has confirmed it is taking part in the prequalification phase of Norway's competition to develop a new class of standardised naval vessels for the Royal Norwegian Navy. The post Kongsberg joins bid for Norway new navy vessel fleet first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Canada begins build of destroyer test site in Nova Scotia
item.description: Canada has begun construction of a new land based test facility intended to support the introduction of the Royal Canadian Navy’s future River class destroyers. The post Canada begins build of destroyer test site in Nova Scotia first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Shapps defends secrecy over Afghan data breach handling
item.description: Former defence secretary Sir Grant Shapps has defended his decision to withhold briefings from senior parliamentarians for around a month following the Afghan data breach, telling MPs he believed wider disclosure could have put lives at risk. The post Shapps defends secrecy over Afghan data breach handling first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD launches new office to boost defence work for SMEs
item.description: The Defence Office for Small Business Growth has been established to help small and medium-sized firms bid for and win defence contracts. The post MOD launches new office to boost defence work for SMEs first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
